description: Find a building in Bavaria by its address, for the solar roof check. Returns up to 5 matches with a house id (up to 20 when the address has no house number yet). If several match, ask the person which one before planning. If the person knows only the town (or a village of it), give just that name: the answer lists the town's streets (a village is mapped to its town only where the data knows it; in a big town the list waits for the first letters of a street), and a street with its town lists its house numbers.

address.description: Street, house number and town (or postcode) in Bavaria, e.g. "Forststraße 10, Neuried"; or only the town (or a village of it) when the person knows only the place, e.g. "Halblech", and the answer lists its streets.

name: find_house
title: Find a house (solar roof check)
